Hi Kate / Michael —

Great to meet with you both on today’s call. As promised, I’ve attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed, proposed owners, and target dates. Quick recap of the key milestones we agreed on: 

- Pilot scope & success metrics defined (Owner: Kate / NovaFin Analytics) — target: 2027-05-15
- Technical POC (integration + security review) (Owner: Michael) — target: 2027-05-30
- Procurement & legal sign-off (Owner: Procurement) — target: 2027-06-15
- Pilot launch (Owner: Redwood + NovaFin) — target close: 2027-06-30

Ask: can you confirm owners above and flag any constraints we should add to dependencies column? If procurement wants separate milestones for SOC 2 evidence and contract review, we can split those out.

I attached: NovaFin_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (draft). I’ll update based on your input and send weekly checkpoints to keep us aligned.

Next steps
- Kate: confirm owners and success metrics by EOD 2027-04-14
- Michael: note any integration blockers (network/IP allowlist, sample data) by 2027-04-16
- Marissa: update MAP and share v1.1

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
